adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` will turn escaped entities (e.g. `<script>`) back into literal tags. That content is then imported via `TopicEmbed.import`, which creates posts with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`. `Post#cook` explicitly returns `raw` for `:raw_html`, bypassing the normal cooking/sanitization pipeline, and `app/views/embed/best.html.erb` renders `raw post.cooked`. Together, this can re-arm escaped HTML from the feed into executable markup (XSS) in the embedded/comments output.
